_seo.descrizione: Meet LA MAISON GROUP: investors and property managers who buy, enhance and manage income-producing properties in Northern Italy. Our team and the way we work.

intestazione.testo_1: We buy, renovate and manage income-producing properties, and we put our experience at the service of owners who want their home to earn without the hassle.

la_nostra_storia.testo_1: *LA MAISON GROUP* was born from a simple idea: every property owner deserves a single partner who can take care of everything. Short-term and long-term rentals, sales, investment advice: one point of contact, one goal – getting the best out of your property.
la_nostra_storia.testo_2: Before being consultants, we are investors: we buy and renovate properties ourselves. We know what it really takes to add value to a home and make it pay over time, and we advise you as we would advise ourselves.
la_nostra_storia.foto_1_alt: Handshake between an owner and a consultant

il_team.testo_2: Looks after owners from the first valuation to day-to-day management, with clear reports and always a direct line.
il_team.testo_4: Leads the acquisition, renovation and enhancement projects: he turns properties in need of work into investments that pay.

i_nostri_valori.testo_1: We always tell you how things stand: realistic valuations, clear costs and regular updates, whether you are renting, selling or investing.
i_nostri_valori.testo_2: We look after every property as if it were our own: from the first visit to the signing of the contract, and on to day-to-day management.
i_nostri_valori.testo_3: No standard solutions: we listen to your goals and build the right strategy for your property together.

invito_finale.testo_1: Let's talk: we will suggest the best solution between management, rental and sale, with a free, no-obligation valuation.
